name: AI members
about: An AI that works here like a person given access: who it works for, its standing instructions, what it is granted. It writes only in its own space; every other change it proposes, and a person accepts it. Used by the orchestrator pipeline (and any agent step that names it).

owner.label: Works for (portal user)
owner.hint: Its work runs on this person's behalf and never reaches more than they may. Only they (and the people below) may work with it.

users.label: Others who may work with it

system.label: Standing instructions
system.hint: Written by a person. The AI proposes changes to them; it never edits them.

read_first.label: Shared files it reads at every start
read_first.hint: [{"project": slug, "file": path}]: preferences, skills, house rules kept in a Muninn project you both see. Changed by proposal.

grants.label: What it is granted
grants.hint: space: its own space (notes, direct); projects: true or [slugs] (through their masks as agent:<this id>); files: the code space (proposals only); tools: [pipelines]; skills: [skills]; delegate: {"most": 3, "rounds": 30} lets it hand tasks to sub-agents with part of these grants.
